title: Fox and Calderón Rally Behind Chihuahua Governor Maru Campos — Brands Morena a 'Perfect Dictatorship'
detail: Vicente Fox and Felipe Calderón appear together at a PAN rally at Expo Chihuahua backing Governor María Eugenia 'Maru' Campos, whom they describe as the target of political persecution for her state government's anti-cartel operations in the Sierra Tarahumara. Fox accuses the federal government of shielding Sinaloa Governor Rubén Rocha Moya — under investigation in US courts — while pursuing Campos, and calls Morena the country's new 'dictadura perfecta,' inverting the term historically used against the PRI machine Fox's own 2000 victory ended. Fox frames the event as an opening mobilization for the 2027 midterms. The rally draws PAN leadership and thousands of attendees.

media.caption: Fox and Calderón join Chihuahua Governor Maru Campos at a PAN rally in Chihuahua
